text: The Sales Director reports that the Territory page's headline card and detail table show different Total Sales numbers for the same filtered territory. A different number isn't enough to act on yet.
First, reproduce it exactly as reported. Set the slicer to Southwest, read the headline card, read the table's Southwest row, and write both numbers down.
Then isolate the variable. Repeat the same comparison for Northwest, then a third territory, changing only the territory and watching what does and doesn't change.
The table's Total Sales changes correctly for each territory. The headline card never changes at all, no matter which territory is selected. That's the real tell, not just that the numbers differ.
That's a lead, not an accusation yet. Next lesson follows it to confirm the actual cause, before anything gets changed.
